import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        String[] nau = new String[n];
        String[] pom = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) nau[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pom[i] = sc.nextLine();

        int[][] odl = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(odl[i], 1000);
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        odl[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && 
                    nau[nx].charAt(ny) >= '0' && nau[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9' && odl[nx][ny] == 1000) {
                    odl[nx][ny] = odl[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        final int K = 60, D = 10;
        final int total = K * D * D * D * D;
        boolean[] moge = new boolean[total];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                        nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9' &&
                        nau[ni].charAt(nj) >= '0' && nau[ni].charAt(nj) <= '9') {
                        int idx = ((((0 * D + i) * D + j) * D + ni) * D + nj);
                        moge[idx] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 0; k <= t - 2; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            int idx = ((((k * D + i) * D + j) * D + l) * D + m);
                            if (!moge[idx]) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                                int nl = l + dx[d], nm = m + dy[d];
                                if (nl >= 0 && nl < n && nm >= 0 && nm < n &&
                                    nau[nl].charAt(nm) >= '0' && nau[nl].charAt(nm) <= '9' &&
                                    odl[l][m] >= k + 2 && odl[nl][nm] >= k + 2) {
                                    int nidx = (((( (k+1) * D + i) * D + j) * D + nl) * D + nm);
                                    moge[nidx] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    a.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int V = 2 * a.size() + 2;
        List<List<Edge>> G = new ArrayList<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int cap1 = nau[a.get(i)[0]].charAt(a.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            addEdge(G, 0, i + 1, cap1);
            int cap2 = pom[a.get(i)[0]].charAt(a.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            addEdge(G, a.size() + 1 + i, V - 1, cap2);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                boolean reach = false;
                for (int k = 0; k <= t - 1; k++) {
                    int idx = ((((k * D + a.get(i)[0]) * D + a.get(i)[1]) * D + a.get(j)[0]) * D + a.get(j)[1]);
                    if (moge[idx]) {
                        reach = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (reach) {
                    addEdge(G, i + 1, a.size() + 1 + j, 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[V];
            int[] par = new int[V];
            Arrays.fill(par, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
            vis[0] = true;
            q2.add(0);
            while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q2.poll();
                for (Edge e : G.get(u)) {
                    if (!vis[e.to] && e.cap > 0) {
                        vis[e.to] = true;
                        par[e.to] = u;
                        q2.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (par[V - 1] == -1) break;

            int add = 1000;
            for (int v = V - 1; v != 0; v = par[v]) {
                int u = par[v];
                for (Edge e : G.get(u)) {
                    if (e.to == v) add = Math.min(add, e.cap);
                }
            }

            for (int v = V - 1; v != 0; v = par[v]) {
                int u = par[v];
                for (Edge e : G.get(u)) {
                    if (e.to == v) e.cap -= add;
                }
                for (Edge e : G.get(v)) {
                    if (e.to == u) e.cap += add;
                }
            }
            flow += add;
        }

        System.out.println(flow);
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(List<List<Edge>> G, int from, int to, int cap) {
        G.get(from).add(new Edge(to, G.get(to).size(), cap));
        G.get(to).add(new Edge(from, G.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
    }
}
